The policy states: *“Comprehensive shipping authorization is granted to a maritime operator with deep-sea vessel compliance that holds an International Maritime Safety Certificate.”*  

This can be parsed as a single logical group with two required conditions that must both hold (AND):
1. The maritime operator **holds an International Maritime Safety Certificate**.  
2. The maritime operator **has deep-sea vessel compliance** (i.e., is in compliance for deep-sea operations).

There is **no "or"** alternative in the policy, so there is only **one group** containing these two conditions.

- **Condition 2: “has deep-sea vessel compliance”.**

  (Ocean vessel compliance implies deep-sea vessel compliance, satisfying the condition.)

No other candidates more precisely satisfy these conditions, so we select these two. All other items are unrelated to Oceanic Express’s deep-sea compliance or safety certificate.
